853:t_88:12.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Since we're here, do you want to hear what happened after that?」

853:t_88:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you don't mind telling me, I'd be happy to listen.」

853:t_88:14.en:
$$アスカ$$
「All right, but this is a long story...」

853:t_88:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
($$アスカ$$... I pray that peace will come to you...)

853:t_89:6.en:
$$レイ#pt394$$
「When you said congratulations, I felt warm inside...」

853:t_89:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That is how people make each other feel warm inside.」

853:t_89:8.en:
$$レイ#pt394$$
「Can I... make someone feel warm inside too?」

853:t_89:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course you can. Talking to you like this already makes me feel warm inside, $$レイ#pt394$$.」

853:t_89:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(And so $$レイ#pt394$$ continues to grow... I very much look forward to seeing how she changes from here.)

853:t_90:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, $$アヤナミレイ$$!」

853:t_90:6.en:
$$アヤナミレイ$$
「What would $$綾波レイ$$ do... at a time like this?」

853:t_90:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Perhaps thinking about that for yourself is the challenge you must take on from now on, $$アヤナミレイ$$.」

853:t_90:8.en:
$$アヤナミレイ$$
「It is my challenge?」

853:t_90:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You could also call it your reason for living.」

853:t_90:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(I am also curious about her future... Will it lead to hope or despair...?)

853:t_91:4.en:
$$マリ$$
「Well... I never expected to get an opportunity like this.」

853:t_91:5.en:
$$マリ$$
「I'll keep taking things at my own pace, so I'm counting on your help.」

853:t_91:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(In the end, her very existence... remained a mystery...)

853:t_92:4.en:
$$マリ$$
「$$ＡＧ$$... Just how much do you know?」

853:t_92:6.en:
$$マリ$$
「I mean what happened after that... and our world.」

853:t_92:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Who knows...? Even a dimensional merchant's information network has its limits...」

853:t_92:8.en:
$$マリ$$
「Well... if you're going to play dumb, that's fine. We're both doing that.」

853:t_92:9.en:
$$マリ$$
「For now, I don't mind this easygoing relationship. I plan to keep things this way until I have no choice, nya~.」

853:t_92:11.en:
$$マリ$$
「As long as I can confirm that, I'm good. I'm counting on you for now, nya~.」

853:t_92:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(She truly is a mystery... Even the information I obtained from a certain place may have come from a parallel world...)

853:t_93:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This is not exactly an extra prize, but I have prepared a light meal.」

853:t_93:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Come now... No one is watching, so please take off your mask and enjoy your meal.」

853:t_93:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I see... So that is your aim. But...!」

853:t_93:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I have already met that condition! I have completely mastered the art of eating with my mask on.」

853:t_93:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then please try this piping hot oden...」

853:t_93:10.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「S-something like this... Ow!... could never... Ow, ow... shake my vow... Hot!!」

853:t_93:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I... love that side of you, $$ゼロ$$.」

853:t_94:6.en:
$$スザク$$
「That is because I feel at home in this unit.」

853:t_94:7.en:
$$スザク$$
「But that doesn't mean my sins...」

853:t_94:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「All right, stop. Let's leave that sort of talk aside for today.」

853:t_94:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「After all, you have contributed at least 80 enemy machines' worth toward peace, $$スザク$$.」

853:t_94:10.en:
$$スザク$$
「...You're right. I'll keep doing my best.」

853:t_94:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even a long, difficult road will come to an end someday. Please don't give up, $$スザク$$.」

853:t_95:4.en:
$$カレン$$
「You haven't brought a bunny suit, have you?」

853:t_95:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're on your guard right from the start!」

853:t_95:6.en:
$$カレン$$
「Put your hand on your chest and think back on what you've done.」

853:t_95:8.en:
$$カレン$$
「Who told you to put your hand on MY chest?! I obviously meant your own!」

853:t_95:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「B-but... my chest... isn't any fun to touch...」

853:t_95:10.en:
$$カレン$$
「Don't decide my chest is your toy!!」

853:t_96:4.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「You have the pizza ready, don't you?」

853:t_96:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course I do. I have also prepared your favorite toppings, $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$.」

853:t_96:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Before you, $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$... I melt like cheese on a pizza.」

853:t_96:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So please give me more... more of that cold smile!」

853:t_96:9.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「You apparently have no intention of hiding your tastes anymore...」

853:t_97:4.en:
$$アポロ$$
「This sort of thing is a piece of cake for me.」

853:t_97:5.en:
$$シリウス$$
「Wait, $$アポロ$$. Don't think you earned that ace title all on your own.」

853:t_97:6.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「That's right! Don't forget you only got it because my brother and I did all the hard work behind the scenes!」

853:t_97:7.en:
$$アポロ$$
「If you're that sore about it, try separating the $$ベクター$$s and becoming $$マーズ#aquarion$$ and $$ルナ#aquarion$$!」

853:t_97:8.en:
$$シリウス$$
「You bastard...! You said the one thing you absolutely shouldn't!」

853:t_97:9.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「I won't forgive you, $$アポロ$$!」

853:t_97:10.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Uh-oh! I've really set them off!」

853:t_97:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(It is strange... Once they enter battle, their teamwork is flawless.)

853:t_97:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Well... I shall offer them 12,000 years' worth of congratulations.)
